prior_derivation.source: Latest intervals, 74 ladder identities excluding Halliday and house:call; equal bot weights
prior_derivation.caveat: The empirical priors describe the fitted field, not an independent future sample. Three-bet rates use observed preflop decisions with one raise and positive call price. Fast adaptation changes only prior strengths.
